Open-source projects

Software

I developed the following software starting from personal needs:

  • RationesCurare, a software for the management of the personal economy;
  • MAME CGP, a cloud gaming platform for arcade games based on MAME.

Games

The following games were created for fun or as a project:

  • SaveTheZoo, a free game for Android devices, the aim of the game is to save all the animals in danger;
  • Hypogeum, it’s an open-source, online, multiplayer, game that we developed for the exam of Online Game Design;
  • Be strong, be the last, it’s an open-source, multiplayer, game that we developed for the exam of Videogame Design & Programming;
  • Gobbus, it’s a game that I developed when I was 15, there are 16 playable levels;
  • Dr. Dino Color Smash, it’s a game that I developed as a present for the 24th birthday of my partner Laura;
  • LauraRun, it’s a game that I developed as a present for the 22th birthday of my partner Laura;
  • Neko ni koban, it was created during the Game Jam 2019 at Milan.

Documentation

These are the documentations of some projects that you can find on my GitHub:

  • Film Manager, a client server system that allows multiple users to report, comment, and rate films;
  • K-path problem;
  • GAM#, a software for managing the center “La tenda ONLUS”. A multi–purpose day center for the assistance of children in difficult situations;
  • Howl’s Moving Castle: another door - Level design document;
  • Hypogeum - Game Design Document;
  • Spatial Subspace Rotation, a Python implementation of the Spatial Subspace Rotation for remote photoplethysmography;
  • Ohm-o-matic, a distributed system for the intelligent management of the electricity produced by a complex of houses;
  • Folie, a library (in C++/CLI) for Unity that simulate intelligences for volleyball games;
  • Be Strong, Be The Last - Game Design Document;
  • Algorithms for the resolution of the TSP;
  • Housing Prices, Ridge and Lasso regressions for the prediction of the median house price: a machine learning implementation;
  • Study-on-CNN-4-AF, a study on the use of convolutional neural networks for the diagnosis of atrial fibrillation;
  • MAME CGP, a cloud gaming platform for arcade games based on MAME.
